source_policy: Sealed original native RGB surfaces and exact completed MVS runs; immutable sources, display-only exports. Pending runs are never substituted.
prior_color_policy: Current photographs projected on unchanged prior geometry using same-prior visibility; appearance only.
mvs_color_policy: Default actual COLMAP depth backprojection plus original photo RGB; original paired OpenMVS fused RGB point cloud as a separately labeled option.
uas_color_policy: Recover original 16-bit LAZ RGB by exact frozen reference raw-row IDs, verify XYZ, divide channels by 256.
new_geometry_policy: MVS GeoGS is always a native RGB raw TSDF512 surface. Resolve exact-run canonical extractions first, completed matched-comparison extractions second. Missing surfaces stay pending; never substitute Gaussian centers. Other six panels retain their existing representations; no extra GPU work.
